summary: The county jail booked 19 people on criminal charges dated Friday, Nov. 13, among them a family-harassment arrest, a trooper DUI arrest and two Daphne drug arrests. No new court releases, agency statements or news reports on Baldwin crime were found overnight.

entries.title: Family harassment arrest: Dewayne Ray Mann
body: Dewayne Ray Mann, 28, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 1:57 a.m. Friday, Nov. 13, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.
He was booked on a charge of harassing a family member — harassment directed at a family or household member. He was in custody when the roster was read early Saturday.

entries.title: Drug arrests, Daphne: Clinton Owen Robert, Logan Dean Becken
body: Daphne police arrested Clinton Owen Robert, 40, and Logan Dean Becken, 32, at 10:26 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 12, at Renaissance Boulevard and U.S. 98, according to the department's arrest log, which lists possession of a controlled substance for both. The two were booked into the county jail Friday, Nov. 13; the jail roster stamps their arrests at 10:24 and 11:18 a.m. that day.

Both were booked on charges of possessing dangerous drugs — illegal possession of a controlled substance — and drug paraphernalia; Robert was also booked on second-degree marijuana possession. The roster shows Becken released Nov. 13; Robert was in custody when the roster was read early Saturday.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 13: Ryan Gabriel Vaughn, Justin Omar Williams, Jermey Dewayne Hileman, Jamarion Royster, Johnathan David Higgins, Jerry Wilson Ray, Elijah Luis Bentley
body: State troopers arrested Ryan Gabriel Vaughn, 34, at 2:27 p.m. Friday, Nov. 13, on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol. The sheriff's office arrested Justin Omar Williams, 38, at 9:11 p.m. and booked him on charges of attempting to elude police and drug paraphernalia. Bay Minette police arrested Jermey Dewayne Hileman, 47, at 7:34 p.m. on a theft charge under a grand jury arrest warrant and a failure-to-appear charge, and Jamarion Royster, 20, at 4:46 p.m. on a charge of possessing dangerous drugs. All four were in custody when the roster was read early Saturday.

The sheriff's office also arrested Johnathan David Higgins, 33, at 1:32 p.m. on a theft charge and Jerry Wilson Ray, 59, at 3 p.m. on a charge of harassing communications — repeated or threatening messages meant to harass; the roster shows both released the same day. Elijah Luis Bentley, 20, released Nov. 12 after a trooper arrest on a reckless-endangerment charge, was booked again Nov. 13 by the sheriff's office on a probation-violation charge. All information is from the jail roster.

entries.agency: Baldwin County Sheriff; Bay Minette Police
entries.title: Domestic arrests Nov. 12: Michael Dewayne Stewart, Johnny Frank Robinson Jr.
body: Michael Dewayne Stewart, 38, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 8:52 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 12, and Johnny Frank Robinson Jr., 48, was arrested by Bay Minette police at 11:29 a.m. the same day, according to the jail roster. No agency statement or news report was found for either arrest.

Stewart was booked on a theft charge and a charge of third-degree domestic violence involving criminal mischief — damaging property of a family or household member. Robinson was booked on a charge of harassing a family member. The roster shows Robinson released Nov. 13; Stewart was in custody when the roster was read early Saturday.

entries.title: Organized retail theft arrest: Lamon Arnold
body: Lamon Arnold, 52, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 11:13 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 12, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.
He was booked on a charge of organized retail theft — stealing merchandise from stores, typically to resell it. He was in custody when the roster was read early Saturday.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 11–12: David Kish Lawrence, Ann Marie Clark, Alton Heath Burkett, Richard Earl Smith, Javonte Laushaun Armstrong, Elijah Luis Bentley
body: The sheriff's office arrested David Kish Lawrence, 59, at 1 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 12, and booked him on charges of possessing a synthetic narcotic, drug paraphernalia, tampering with physical evidence and failure to appear on a felony. Fairhope police arrested Ann Marie Clark, 48, at 9:29 a.m. Nov. 12 near Greeno Road; she was booked on charges of methamphetamine possession and drug paraphernalia. Gulf Shores police arrested Alton Heath Burkett, 45, at 6:16 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 11, on a methamphetamine possession charge.

Richard Earl Smith, 56, arrested by the sheriff's office at 11:08 p.m. Nov. 11, was booked on a charge of possessing dangerous drugs and an alias writ of arrest. Javonte Laushaun Armstrong, 24, arrested by the sheriff's office Nov. 11, was booked on a charge of unlawfully breaking into a vehicle. The roster shows Clark released Nov. 13; the other four were in custody when the roster was read early Saturday. Elijah Luis Bentley, 20, arrested by state troopers Nov. 11, was booked Nov. 12 on a reckless endangerment charge and released the same day. Those arrested Nov. 11 were booked into the jail Nov. 12. Information is from the jail roster and the Fairhope police arrest log.

entries.title: Indicted, elder financial exploitation: John McNider, Angel McNider
body: A Baldwin County grand jury has indicted John McNider, 56, and Angel McNider, 54, owners of an Orange Beach boat-lift business, on a combined eight counts of financial exploitation of the elderly, FOX10 reported Thursday, citing court documents filed this week. The station said the documents name six alleged victims and put the value in each case above $2,500.

FOX10 reported that John McNider also faces two counts of first-degree theft of property and Angel McNider one, and that both face an electronic stalking charge. Angel McNider's attorney told the station she has not spoken to the person named in that charge in three years. Both were released from the county jail; their arraignment is set for Jan. 20, the station reported.
